WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
total_matched AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM matched_records
),
conservation_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_matched) as fraction
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST) as dense_rank
  FROM conservation_totals
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  insurstat,
  record_count,
  fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE dense_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, insurstat DESC NULLS LAST
